name: verdure-functions
description: Server-authoritative game logic + notifications for Verdure

scripts.e2e: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "node functions/scripts/e2e-backend.mjs"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.redteam: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "node functions/scripts/redteam.mjs"
scripts.test:units: npm run check:classifier && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:indexes && npm run build && node scripts/fulfillment-unit.mjs && node scripts/subscription-unit.mjs && node scripts/ingest-unit.mjs && node scripts/ranking-unit.mjs && node scripts/ranking-v2-unit.mjs && node scripts/notifications-unit.mjs && node scripts/partners-unit.mjs && node scripts/event-planner-unit.mjs && node scripts/adventure-engine-unit.mjs && node scripts/parks-unit.mjs && node scripts/offline-unit.mjs && node scripts/programs-unit.mjs && node scripts/place-stories-unit.mjs && node scripts/rank-eval-unit.mjs && node scripts/discovery-unit.mjs && node scripts/run-all-unit.mjs
scripts.e2e:discovery: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/discovery-e2e.mjs"
scripts.e2e:discovery:record: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/discovery-e2e.mjs --record"
scripts.seed:partners: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/seed-partners.mjs"
scripts.coverage:emulator: cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/coverage-check.mjs"
scripts.corpus:local: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/local-corpus-gate.mjs"
scripts.e2e:ingest: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/ingest-write-path-e2e.mjs"
scripts.baseline: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/baseline.mjs --label run"
scripts.e2e:sources: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/sources-e2e.mjs"
scripts.migrate:sources:emulator: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/migrate-sources.mjs"
scripts.acceptance: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project connectify-19dd8 "node functions/scripts/sprint-acceptance.mjs"
